title: Brighter Twilights
description: A datapack that changes sunrise/sunset to a nonlinear transition, the result being lighter twilight hours
body:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/k0NbBP3zpx4" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>
Have you ever been wandering around at sunset and wondered, "I'm looking at the sun, why is it so dark??". This datapack aims to fix this.

It changes the light levels to be brighter at sunset and sunrise by using a cubic interpolation instead of the linear interpolation vanilla uses. It also slightly moves back the time that full night sets in

![Comparison of a vanilla and modded sunset](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bb25d9c27f4fa6e186990a4c7faf7fb473bcdc63_0.webp)

For the nerds:

![Plot showing the original and new light curves. The new one is generally above the original](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/09ad661b1fd0f86c7ae088c3a4e37237e2214098.png)
